question: Which part of the plant is responsible for transporting water from roots of the plant to the rest of the plant?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Xylem tissue.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Water and solutes are moved by **the xylem** from the roots to the leaves.
 
• **The xylem** distributes water and dissolved minerals upward through the plant, from the roots to the leaves.
 
• Xylem cells form the crucial part of a mature woody stem or root.
 
• **The xylem is located towards the adaxial surface of the leaf.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd4384c67de181070a25595eb65ff9d1f4179c8867e81caa266eb735c787348a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The phloem is in charge of the **transport and distribution of sugars produced by photosynthesis**.​ 
 
• Collenchyma helps to **provide strength to the plant's stems, branches, leaves, and other structures**.
 
• The chief work of parenchyma is to **store and assimilate food**.
